Number of units ordered per transaction line. Negative values indicate product returns or reversals.
Exact date and time when the transaction was generated.
Product price per unit stated in British Pounds Sterling.
Unique 5-digit customer identifier. Contains 107,927 missing entries.
Geographic region where the transaction or customer is located (40 unique countries).
